input: Build a capsule first-aid kit for road trips

gold.taskTitle: Build a Capsule First-Aid Kit for Road Trips
gold.taskDescription: Assemble a compact, purpose-built first-aid kit specifically designed for road trip use.

questions.title: How many people will the kit need to cover?
questions.description: Understanding group size determines quantities of supplies needed.

questions.title: Do any travelers have known medical conditions or allergies?
questions.description: Specific health needs may require prescription items or specialised supplies.

questions.title: What type of vehicle will the kit be stored in?
questions.description: Storage space and temperature conditions vary by vehicle type.

questions.title: What kind of terrain or activities are planned on the trip?
questions.description: Hiking, off-roading, or urban driving each carry different injury risks.

questions.title: Do you want to buy a pre-made kit or build from scratch?
questions.description: This determines whether the plan focuses on sourcing individual items or customising an existing kit.

questions.title: What is your budget for assembling this kit?
questions.description: Budget shapes which items and brands are realistic to include.

questions.title: Are any travelers trained in first aid or CPR?
questions.description: Skill level affects which advanced supplies are appropriate to include.
